profile_text.body:
# Microsoft

Microsoft, founded in 1975 and headquartered in Redmond, WA, is a public company with revenue of $331.839 billion as of June 30, 2026. The company describes Power Automate as a workflow automation platform that automates business processes across apps, systems, and websites using AI, digital, and robotic process automation. The site notes that generative AI and Power Automate can reduce labor requirements, citing an example where a process previously requiring over 100 people can now be managed by a smaller team.

Beyond Power Automate, Microsoft operates a broad AI product portfolio spanning multiple categories. This includes Azure OpenAI Service and Azure Machine Learning for cloud AI services, Microsoft Copilot embedded across Microsoft 365 applications, Microsoft Designer for image generation, and Microsoft Teams AI for meeting recaps. The company also offers developer tools including Semantic Kernel, AutoGen for multi-agent orchestration, and the Microsoft Agent Framework, which the held data notes will supersede Semantic Kernel and AutoGen in 2026. Additional products include SharePoint AI for enterprise content, Microsoft Clipchamp AI for video editing, and Power Automate AI for enterprise workflow automation with Copilot integration and data loss prevention.

Microsoft faces litigation exposure including The New York Times Co. v. Microsoft Corp. and OpenAI and Authors Guild v. OpenAI, Inc., both filed in U.S. District Court, S.D. New York. The company operates with significant legal exposure in Washington state, where 86 cases are tracked.
